# interval before

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalBefore`](gmeow-intervalBefore.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalBefore>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen BEFORE: this interval ends strictly before the related interval begins. Transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:intervalAfter`](gmeow-intervalAfter.md). (= [time:intervalBefore](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalBefore))

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to assert that one [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) ends strictly before another begins with a gap between — the qualitative ordering when exact dateTimes are unknown or beside the point.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the intervals touch with no gap (use [`gmeow:intervalMeets`](gmeow-intervalMeets.md)) and avoid using it as a substitute for crisp bounds that are actually known; assert the dateTimes and let comparison follow.

### How to use

- Assert between two [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) individuals; transitivity chains the ordering, and the inverse [`gmeow:intervalAfter`](gmeow-intervalAfter.md) follows automatically (= [time:intervalBefore](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalBefore)).

### Examples

- ex:jurassic [`gmeow:intervalBefore`](gmeow-intervalBefore.md) ex:cretaceous.
